roles.headline: Data Engineer & AI Enthusiast
roles.detailed: Data Engineering · AI/ML · Full Stack Development · AI Systems

bio: Recent B.Tech graduate in Computer Science (Cyber Security) and currently working as a Data Engineer Trainee at Insight Enterprises. Experienced in building enterprise-grade Azure Data Factory pipelines, metadata-driven ETL frameworks, and scalable data solutions using Azure SQL and ADLS Gen2. Passionate about Data Engineering, AI, Machine Learning, and Full Stack Development, with a focus on designing cloud-native, production-ready applications that solve real-world problems through automation and intelligent systems.

bullets: Completed Microsoft Azure AZ-900 and DP-900 certifications, strengthening expertise in cloud computing, Azure data services, and modern data engineering concepts.
Researched Power BI Semantic Search in multi-tenant workspaces and developed a proof-of-concept (PoC) to evaluate enterprise search capabilities and metadata discovery.

Designed and implemented a metadata-driven Azure Data Engineering Pipeline as a personal practice project using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, PySpark, Delta Lake, and Medallion Architecture, featuring automated ingestion, reusable notebooks, schema validation, and Bronze-Silver-Gold transformations.
experience.desc: Working as a Data Engineer Trainee in the Data & AI team, gaining hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric technologies. Completed Azure certifications, researched enterprise Power BI capabilities, developed proof-of-concepts, and independently built a metadata-driven Azure Data Engineering Pipeline to strengthen practical data engineering skills.

bullets: Contributed to the development of production-oriented AI applications involving NLP, Computer Vision, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Deep Learning, and Vector Databases using Qdrant.
Developed backend APIs, built AI prototypes, performed model evaluation, prompt engineering, and supported fine-tuning workflows for intelligent applications.

Worked on live projects including CLAN Notification System using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) and an AI-powered Video Interview System that analyzed candidate posture, speech, communication, and behavioral attributes for automated interview assessment.
experience.desc: Worked on research and development of AI-powered applications using modern machine learning and generative AI technologies. Contributed to production-ready projects involving computer vision, NLP, RAG, vector databases, backend APIs, and intelligent candidate assessment systems.

projects.title: Metadata-Driven Lakehouse
projects.subtitle: Onboard a new data source with one metadata row, not a new pipeline.
projects.desc: Config-driven ingestion from Bronze to a Gold star schema with data-quality checks, PII masking, OpenLineage lineage and an audit trail. Apache Arrow benchmarked at 16× Spark throughput on 1M rows; 499 tests, 96% coverage.

projects.title: Agentic Pipeline Copilot
projects.subtitle: Plain-English spec in, a validated and tested PySpark notebook out, opened as a pull request.
projects.desc: An LLM agent that generates PySpark from a spec, executes it in a Docker sandbox, tests it and opens a pull request for human review. It never merges its own work. An eval suite gates CI.

projects.title: Evidence-Grounded Résumé Engine
projects.subtitle: A résumé generator where every claim must cite verified evidence.
projects.desc: RAG plus an NLI verifier gate cut the fabrication rate of kept bullets from 23% to 0% on a hand-labelled golden set (95% upper bound 7%), and blocks all 34 payloads in its prompt-injection suite. Fabrication is measured, not promised.

projects.title: Real-Time ASL Recognition
projects.subtitle: ASL alphabet recognition on CPU that says "not confident" instead of guessing.
projects.desc: MediaPipe hand crop feeding an INT8-quantised MobileNetV2 in ONNX: 99.96% accuracy, 1.33 ms p50 on CPU, 97× faster than the FP32 Keras model, with a calibrated confidence threshold. Runs in the browser via onnxruntime-web.

projects.title: Neighborhood Skill Swap
projects.subtitle: A full-stack skill-swap board with the security most demo apps skip.
projects.metric: Authorization tested on every owned object
projects.desc: React, FastAPI and Postgres with rotating refresh tokens, Argon2id password hashing, rate-limited auth endpoints and authorization tests on every owned resource. Playwright E2E runs in CI.

publications.title: Explainable & Adversarially Robust Fileless Malware Detection
publications.desc: Engineered a memory-forensics malware detection system using LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, SHAP, and Volatility. Achieved 100% binary classification accuracy with a soft-voting ensemble, reduced features by 73%, and validated robustness against adversarial attacks.
